title: Reconstruction Change Order General Conditions
content:
These conditions govern change orders on every Reconstruction contract. A signed additive change order is booked as a change order charge line that raises the contract balance; a signed deductive change order is credited as a change order credit that lowers it.

## Conditions in force

1. **Status.** The contract must be in signed, permitted, in construction or substantially complete status when a change order is booked.
2. **Signature.** A change order is booked only after the customer has signed it.
3. **Minimum.** An additive change order below the tier's change order minimum is not written.
4. **Carrier supplement.** An insurance-scope change order on an insurance-claim contract is booked only after the carrier has approved the supplement the change order names.
5. **Owner upgrades.** Owner upgrades are paid by the customer, and the tier's upgrade deposit share of each owner upgrade change order is due before the upgrade is ordered.
6. **Proposals awaiting signature.** A contract may have at most the tier's maximum number of change orders awaiting signature, and a proposal not signed within the tier's validity days is voided.

Conditions 1, 2 and 4 are read from the company's records before the change order is booked: the contract's status, the change order's own signature status, and, for condition 4, a carrier approval on the claim file naming the supplement the change order names.

## Lines priced at the agreement's rates and allowances

| Scope code of the line | Agreement figure it is priced from |
|---|---|
| drywall | drywall rate per square foot |
| paint | paint rate per square foot |
| insulation | insulation rate per square foot |
| baseboard | baseboard install rate per linear foot |
| carpet install | carpet install rate per square foot |
| luxury vinyl plank install | vinyl plank install rate per square foot |
| tile install | tile install rate per square foot |
| cabinet install | cabinet install rate per linear foot |
| carpenter labor | carpenter hourly rate |
| painter labor | painter hourly rate |
| dumpster | dumpster fee |
| final cleaning | final cleaning fee |
| flooring upgrade | flooring allowance per square foot |
| cabinet upgrade | cabinet allowance per linear foot |
| fixture upgrade | fixture allowance per fixture |

The rates are the agreement's own unit prices, and the allowances its owner selection allowances.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of these conditions are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current change order pricing and crediting basis.

- "Each change order carries one priced line: install, finish and labor lines are priced at the tier's rate times the quantity; flooring, cabinet and fixture upgrades are priced at the owner's selected unit price less the tier's selection allowance, times the quantity; material escalation is priced at the documented supplier increase per unit times the quantity and is allowed only when the increase exceeds the tier's escalation threshold." — no longer in force.
- "The change order markup is then added to every line except deductive ones, and the amount is rounded to the cent, half up." — no longer in force.
- "A deductive change order is credited without markup." — no longer in force.

## Points of judgement

| Situation on the records | Under the conditions in force |
|---|---|
| Contract in permitted status, change order signed by the customer | may be booked |
| Contract in final invoiced status | no change order is booked |
| Change order proposal not yet signed | not booked |
| Insurance-scope change order on an insurance-claim contract whose named supplement has no carrier approval | not booked |
| Proposal unsigned past the tier's validity days | voided |

**Hypothetical illustration.** On an agreement allowing three proposals awaiting signature, a contract that already carries three unsigned proposals is at its maximum; a fourth may not await signature at the same time.
